tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: List available Minecraft server software and proxy providers with their slugs, descriptions, and latest-version summaries.

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: Browse provider builds in catalog order (newest first). Filter by Minecraft version and channel. Each result groups all operating-system downloads for one build. Stable builds only unless requested otherwise.

tools.name: get_download
tools.description: Get an exact provider build or the newest matching build when version is omitted. Minecraft and loader versions are separate: use minecraftVersion for the game, version for the full provider build. Returns URLs only; does not download or execute files. No match returns an error without substituting
